question: Who among the following created the record in the boys' 1500m by completing the race in 3:51.12 mins at the 6th Khelo India Youth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __Rahul Sarnaliya__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Rahul Sarnaliya** created the record in the boys' 1500m race.
 
• He completed the race in **3:51.12 minutes**, setting a new record.
 
• This achievement took place at the **6th Khelo India Youth Games**.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is an initiative by the Indian Government to promote sports and fitness among the youth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG):**

 
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is a part of the Khelo India programme which was introduced to revive the sports culture in India at the grass-root level.
 
• It is an annual event where students from schools and colleges across India compete in various sports disciplines.
 
• The KIYG aims to scout young talent and provide them with a platform to showcase their skills.
 
• Talented athletes identified through the games are provided with financial assistance and training by the government.
 
 
 
• **1500 meters race:**
 
 
• This is a middle-distance race in track and field competitions, commonly referred to as the "metric mile".
 
• The 1500m race is a standard middle-distance event in both outdoor and indoor track and field championships.
 
• Runners need to maintain a balance of speed and endurance to excel in this event.
 
• The current men's world record for the 1500m is held by Hicham El Guerrouj of Morocco with a time of 3:26.00 minutes, set in 1998.
 
 
 
• **Athletics:**
 
 
• Athletics is a collection of sporting events that involve competitive running, jumping, throwing, and walking.
 
• It is one of the oldest forms of sport and is a core part of the Olympic Games.
 
• Track and field, road running, cross country running, and racewalking are the four main categories of athletics competitions.
 
• Athletes often specialize in one or more events, and they undergo rigorous training to excel in their respective disciplines.
